title: Exactness of the left-resolution chain complex in positive degrees
statement: Let $A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], let $C$ be a category with zero morphisms (every $\mathrm{Hom}(Y,Z)$ has a distinguished element $0$ with $g\circ 0=0$ and $0\circ f=0$), and let $\iota:C\to A$ be fully faithful. For a left-resolution datum $\Lambda=(F,\pi)$ for $\iota$ [lem-sfb-left-resolution-reduced-api] (a functor $F:A\to C$ and a natural transformation $\pi:\iota F\Rightarrow\operatorname{id}_A$ with epimorphic components) and an object $X$ of $A$, let $K=\Lambda.\mathrm{chainComplex}(X)$ be the $\mathbb N$-indexed chain complex of [lem-sfb-left-resolution-chain-complex-functor]. Then the chain complex $\iota K$ in $A$ obtained by applying $\iota$ termwise is exact at every degree $n+1$, $n\in\mathbb N$: the image of $\iota(d_{n+2,n+1})$ equals the kernel of $\iota(d_{n+1,n})$ (Mathlib `CategoryTheory.Abelian.LeftResolution.exactAt_map_chainComplex_succ`).
